description: Modernization tasks for moving ZavaNotifyWorker to Azure.

tasks.description: Migrate notification queue processing from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus.
tasks.reason: Use Azure-managed messaging for queue consumption and dead-letter handling in the notification worker.
tasks.requirements: Replace RabbitMQ queue connectivity, message retrieval, acknowledgement, and dead-letter behavior with Azure Service Bus while preserving current notification-processing behavior and using Managed Identity authentication.

tasks.description: Migrate notification email delivery from SMTP to Azure Communication Services Email.
tasks.reason: Use an Azure-managed email service instead of the current SMTP relay for notification delivery.
tasks.requirements: Replace SMTP-based email sending with Azure Communication Services Email while preserving the current notification content and using Managed Identity authentication.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies and remediate known CVEs before Azure deployment.
tasks.reason: Ensure the modernized worker is free of known dependency vulnerabilities before it is deployed to Azure.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to the minimum patched version. If a CVE fix requires a major version upgrade, document the affected dependency, the current version, the upgraded major version, and the breaking-change risk. Verify that the project builds and applicable tests pass after remediation.

tasks.description: Deploy the notification worker to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: Provide a managed Azure hosting target for the worker after the Azure service migrations are complete.
tasks.requirements: Containerize the worker as needed for Azure Container Apps, configure runtime settings for the Azure-hosted messaging and email integrations, and deploy the application to an existing or externally managed Azure Container Apps environment.
